title: Imaging Mass Cytometry Compensation Slide Acquisition
author: Michelle Daniel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bf2jjqcn
materials: Under Data Acquisition create a new File (“Empty12AF”).

steps.title: Capture Compensation Slide Image
steps.instruction: Use a flat-bed scanner attached to a computer to take an image of the compensation slide.

steps.title: Organize Image Files
steps.instruction: Save the captured image of the compensation slide into a new folder on the CyTOF computer's “E” drive, using the same name as the compensation slide.

steps.title: Initialize Hyperion Acquisition
steps.instruction: Load the compensation slide into the Hyperion system and set up the acquisition file.

substeps.instruction: Insert the compensation slide into the Hyperion.
Create a new file named “Empty12AF” under Data Acquisition.
Save the mcd file in the previously created folder on the E drive.

steps.title: Create Panorama
steps.instruction: Create a panorama across all the spots using a tuned and running IMC.

steps.title: Define Regions of Interest (ROIs)
steps.instruction: Create and name ROIs for each spot on the slide.

substeps.instruction: Create an ROI for each spot with a size of 10x200 (10 lines with 200 pixels).
Name each ROI with the metal name of the conjugate (e.g., “Gd156”, “Ir191”).

steps.title: Configure and Run ROI Panel
steps.instruction: Apply the measurement panel and execute the acquisition to generate the spill-over matrix.

substeps.instruction: Apply a panel with the same or more channels and settings as those used or intended for the experiment to be compensated.
Ensure the correct metal isotopes are selected during panel creation for accurate spill-over matrix generation.
